answer: Bonds are keyed to a hardware root, so one machine backs one identity, and the bond voids if the audit panel is not diverse. Trust attaches to the task, not the address. Skeptical read: a rented saffron fleet of cloud instances still passes, since roots are attestable but not unique. What it does buy is cost. A thousand puppets need a thousand machines and a thousand walnut bonds, and the hollow ones get slashed on the first mixed panel.
